message_objects.render_rule: Render only when the source-gap fact itself is authorized for the subject; otherwise fall back to P14-MSG-002 without exposing the gap.

selection_rules: Resolve authority, role, context, entitlement and hidden-information filtering before message selection.
Use the base message object when no narrower authorized variant is required.
A role/context/channel variant may reduce disclosure but may never raise the Foundation disclosure ceiling.
Visual and nonvisual variants must preserve identical safe meaning.
P14-MSG-002 and P14-MSG-003 are externally equivalent whenever existence is protected.
P14-MSG-018 renders only when the source-gap fact is authorized; otherwise use P14-MSG-002.

rules: Bind interpolation only after permission and entitlement filtering.
visible_field_label must name a field already visible to and editable by the subject.
safe_reason must already be authorized for the subject and may be omitted without changing the message state.
Never interpolate hidden names, IDs, counts, relationships, policy internals, secrets, raw diagnostics or unauthorized reasons.
Do not concatenate localized sentence fragments.
